headline: Ep Biocomposites wins Rs 0.92 Cr STP order from Beleza by the Beach
summary: Ep Biocomposites secures Rs 0.92 crore work order for a 70 KLD Sewage Treatment Plant. The order represents significant backlog addition for the SME utility player.

headline: Beezaasan board to decide on Asawara acquisition
summary: Beezaasan Explotech Ltd board meeting on Sep 30, 2026, will consider acquiring equity shares of associate company Asawara Earthtech Limited.

headline: TGV Sraac shareholders approve MoA object clause change
summary: TGV Sraac Limited shareholders approved alterations to the Memorandum of Association during the AGM held on September 26, 2026. The changes expand business scope to include infrastructure development and real estate.

headline: Kilburn Office Automation posts FY26 loss
summary: Kilburn Office Automation Limited reported a net loss of ₹30.95 lakh in FY26, driven by deferred tax charges and administrative expenses. The company remains non-operational post-CIRP.

headline: Zee Learn faces NCLT petition for ₹821 crore default
summary: ACRE has filed a petition seeking CIRP initiation against Zee Learn and its subsidiary DVPL for an alleged default of approximately ₹821 crore.

headline: Econo Trade closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Econo Trade India Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after declaring Q2FY27 results to comply with insider trading norms.

headline: Brilliant Portfolios AGM concludes; all resolutions passed
summary: Brilliant Portfolios Limited held its 32nd AGM via video conferencing on September 27, 2026. All ordinary and special resolutions, including director re-appointments and remuneration approvals, were passed with requisite majority.

headline: Alldigi Tech to host investor call Sep 30
summary: Alldigi Tech Limited will participate in the Bharat Connect Conference on September 30, 2026. The virtual group meeting is scheduled for 2:00 pm IST.

headline: Vrundavan Plantation closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: Vrundavan Plantation Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after announcing Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: My Money Securities approves auditor re-appointment
summary: My Money Securities Ltd approved the re-appointment of Sharma Goel & Co. LLP as statutory auditors and authorized the acquisition of up to 100% equity in My Money Credits Private Limited.

headline: Raghav Productivity Enhancers hosts White Oak plant visit
summary: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Limited will host a plant visit for White Oak Capital Management at its Newai facility on September 30, 2026. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be shared.
